product_ref: required; your own id for the line; rows sharing one are variants of it
product_name: required; the line, as a shopper would see it
sku: required; unique per row; what everybody outside your systems says
variant_name: required; what distinguishes this row from its siblings
is_base: required; true on exactly one row per product reference
category: required; one of the codes on the Categories sheet
claims: optional; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
compliance.min_age: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; applies to food.alcohol.beer, food.alcohol.spirits, food.alcohol.wine only; the number only, in years - never '65 years'
compliance.sale_permitted: optional; safety - a person reviews any change; true or false
food.allergens.contains: required by CH-WEB, CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B, CH-PRINT; safety - a person reviews any change; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
food.allergens.may_contain: required by CH-WEB, CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B, CH-PRINT; safety - a person reviews any change; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
food.fibre_g: optional; the number only, in g - never '65 g'
food.ingredients: required by CH-WEB, CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B, CH-PRINT; order is part of the value; do not sort; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
food.net_weight_g: optional; the number only, in g - never '65 g'
identifiers.gtin: required by CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B; 14 digits, kept as text - leading zeros are significant
packaging.recyclable_pct: optional; the number only, in % - never '65 %'
image.PACK_FRONT: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
image.INGREDIENT_PANEL: required; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
image.DETAIL: optional; the file name as it appears in images/ inside the bundle
